own_solution.law: t = R_th C ln(1/(1-p)), R_th = R1 R2/(R1+R2)
assumptions: ideal battery and capacitor, uncharged at the start
fraction taken of the final Thevenin voltage

defect_reasons.other: Typo in the scene clause: 'charged from a its own small cell'.

notes: Checks: R_th = 2.7791 kOhm. C = 22 uF: tau = 61.141 ms, t = 140.78 ms. C = 28.2 uF: 78.372 ms * 2.302585 = 180.46 ms; 37 uF: 102.83 ms -> 236.77 ms; 55 uF: 152.85 ms -> 351.96 ms; all match. The emf cancels from the ratio (C claims correct). Minimal pairs hold: T1015 vs TDA93 differ only 'before the switch was closed' -> 'for an earlier run only'; T6164 vs TE837 differ only 'the capacitor' -> 'the flash unit'; same 15 uF. TA387 and T7FFF are declared numeral-free twins (by design). On my pass-1 concern about the added capacitor's initial charge: being in parallel with the capacitor that is stated uncharged when the switch closes, the extra capacitor necessarily has zero voltage too, so no condition is missing. Only defect is the low-severity typo.
